newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ job ad growth remains flat in March - ANZ Bank.
newsitem.headline: NZ job ad growth remains flat in March - ANZ Bank.

text.p: The trend number of New Zealand job advertisements rose 0.4 percent in March, following a 0.5 percent rise in February, ANZ Bank said on Monday.
In annual terms, the trend number of job ads dropped 5.5 percent in March compared with March 1996.
Job advertisements in Auckland and Christchurch rose slightly during March on a month on month basis but continued to fall in the capital.
The trend number of job ads in March 1997 compared to March last year fell in all main and regional centres.

Wellington had an 18.8 percent drop, Auckland 4.1 percent and Christchurch 3.5 percent. However both Auckland and Christchurch recorded monthly trend job ad increases of less than one percent over the previous month of February.
The ANZ bank attributed the downward slide in job advertisement growth as being in line with a gradual moderation of economic activity during 1996.
It saw the figures as a reinforcement of its view economic growth would remain relatively weak over the next three to six months.
